scholarships.title: RISE Germany - Research Internships in Science and Engineering

eligibility: Undergraduate students majoring in the fields of science and engineering as well as in computer science
Applicants must have completed at least two years of undergraduate study
Seniors or fourth-year students must prove that they will still be fully enrolled upon their return to their home university in North America, the UK or Ireland
For most positions knowledge of German is not required
existing.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate students in science, engineering and computer science at North American, British and Irish universities who have completed at least two years of study.
benefits: Monthly stipend of 992 Euro to help cover living expenses
Health, accident and private liability insurance
A lump sum towards international travel costs
A lump sum of 160 Euros for travel within Germany
Invitation to a three-day meeting of all RISE scholars in Germany in July

requirements: Apply completely online through the RISE Germany internship database
Register in the RISE internship database and search the available internship offers
application_method: Register for the RISE internship database
Search the more than 450 internship offers
Submit the online application with the required documents
Have a referee upload the letter of reference within the reference window
existing.selection_notes: Ranks applicants with providers (host institutions) between January 14 and January 25, 2027; internship positions are announced around February/March 2027. About 300 scholarships are available each year.
existing.best_fit: Undergraduate students who have completed at least two years of a science, engineering or computer science degree at a university in North America, the UK or Ireland and want a research internship in Germany in a summer break.
existing.notes: German language is not required for most positions and the working language is English. Research internships take place during the summer break in Germany; host institutions are matched by field of interest (biology, chemistry, physics, earth sciences, engineering, or a closely related field).
existing.application_period: Applications run from October 15 to November 30, 2026; ranking by providers January 14 - January 25, 2027; internship positions announced around February/March 2027.
existing.deadline_display: Applications: October 15 - November 30, 2026 (11:59 pm CET - Central European Time); Letters of reference: October 15 - December 15, 2026
